issue_title: Publish the merged coverage profile as a CI artifact
issue_body: Reviewers want to open the merged coverage profile behind a failing coverage gate without re-running the tests locally. Upload the merged profile from the coverage gate job as a workflow artifact with a short retention period.

plan.summary: Upload the merged coverage profile from the coverage gate job as a seven-day workflow artifact.

approach.description: In the coverage gate job, after the merge step, add an actions/upload-artifact@v4 step uploading coverage-merged.out as the artifact coverage-merged with retention-days: 7.
Run the upload with if: always() so a failing gate still publishes the profile it judged.

verification.test_strategy: Open a pull request and confirm the coverage-merged artifact appears on the run page for both a passing and a failing gate.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every CI run's coverage gate job publishes the merged profile as an artifact.
A failing coverage gate still publishes the profile.

diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 7e21c0a..b3f4d18 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -7,7 +7,8 @@ on:
     branches: [main]
 
 permissions:
-  contents: read
+  contents: write
+  actions: write
 
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
@@ -402,6 +403,13 @@ jobs:
       - name: Merge coverage profiles
         run: scripts/ci-merge-coverage coverage-merged.out
 
+      - name: Upload merged coverage profile
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: coverage-merged
+          path: coverage-merged.out
+          retention-days: 7
+
       - name: Coverage gate
         run: scripts/check-coverage coverage-merged.out

catching_examples.note: ci.yml widens the workflow-level permissions to contents: write and actions: write for every job. Uploading an artifact needs neither; a compromised step could push to the repository. Keep contents: read.
The ci.yml change grants write access the artifact upload does not use.

non_catching_examples.note: ci.yml: retention-days: 7 may be too short for a reviewer who looks a week later.
ci.yml: if: always() also uploads when the merge step failed and the profile is absent; add if-no-files-found: ignore.
The upload step should be gated on the go path filter.
ci.yml: this is a security risk and the change is insecure; harden it.
